testcase.name: known tiny response does not request an oversized transfer buffer
known 199 byte POM uses its response length
known one byte response uses a one byte buffer
identity response uses its uncompressed length
mixed case identity response uses its uncompressed length
other content encodings retain the default maximum
known responses at the default boundary stay bounded
known empty response keeps read buffers at one byte or less
known body larger than configured maximum uses at most that maximum
unknown chunked response retains the default maximum
unknown identity response retains the default maximum
gzip response with known encoded length returns all decoded bytes
partial response resumes from the persisted prefix with a bounded read buffer
